intro:
Mandvi, in Surat district, sits along the Tapi river belt and carries a quieter, more agricultural character than the city of Surat itself, even though it falls within the same district. Weddings here often bring together extended families from both the town and the sugarcane-growing villages around it, and a proper baraat entry, loud and well-lit, is still the moment everyone shows up for.

Plan My Baraat puts together the complete entry for Mandvi weddings as one booking: the double decker Baraat on Wheels truck, a dhol team, a vintage car or baggi for the groom's arrival, and the My Safa team turban-styling him and the full baraati group before the procession starts.
localArea:
Mandvi sits south-east of Surat city, close enough that families here often have work or business ties to Surat, but the town itself keeps its own market-town pace. Roads in and around Mandvi are generally straightforward for a truck our size, with most venues sitting along the main connecting roads rather than tucked into narrow lanes.

We cover Mandvi and the villages around it regularly, including the sugarcane belt areas nearby, and we're used to the mix of town-hall weddings and open-ground celebrations that come up in this part of Surat district.
whatsIncluded:
Every package includes the DJ truck, sound system, and a DJ artist keeping the baraat energised as it moves. Raj Tilak adds 2 dhol and chhatri lighting. Rajwada brings the dhol count to 4 and adds a teddy or gorilla performer working the crowd. Maharaja, the package most Mandvi families choose, adds moving LED panels and lights up the groom's name for the arrival. Signature, our top package, adds a security team, timed pyro and confetti, and an upgraded American vintage car for the entrance.

The vintage car or baggi and the My Safa turban team come standard from Raj Tilak upward, so even the entry-level booking includes a proper car and full turban styling for the group.
whyUs:
We're a Gujarat-based baraat planning team that covers Surat district's smaller towns regularly, and Mandvi is one we know well - our crews are comfortable with the mix of town-centre venues and more open, rural settings that come up here, including celebrations held on open ground near family fields.

Booking one team for the truck, dhol, car, and safa means fewer moving parts for you to manage. We handle the timing so the truck's arrival, the dhol beat, and the groom's step out of the vintage car all come together at your Mandvi venue.
pricingGuidance:
Pricing for a Mandvi baraat depends on the package, dhol count, and whether you're adding effects like pyro or confetti. Raj Tilak gives you the full core setup at the most accessible price; Signature costs more because the production is genuinely bigger, with more dhol, LED visuals, a security team, and the premium American vintage car.

Message us your date, your venue or area in Mandvi, and a rough guest count, and we'll respond on WhatsApp with a real quote, usually within the hour, built around your actual event details.
planningNotes:
Wedding season runs November to February, and Mandvi tends to be less contested for dates than venues closer to Surat city, so 2 to 3 weeks' notice in peak season is usually enough. Outside that window, a week's notice generally works fine for planning purposes.

A rough headcount for the baraati group helps us plan dhol positioning and how much room the truck needs, especially for venues set on open ground rather than a formal hall or banquet space.
closing: Message us on WhatsApp with your wedding date, your venue in Mandvi, and an approximate baraati headcount, and we'll confirm the truck's availability along with a package recommendation, usually within the hour, tailored to your event.
